ASSEMBLED SURFACE BENCH

One environment.
Connected surfaces.

Two wall modules, a corner, a ledge, a drain and pavement. Construction seams stay aligned while detail and weathering vary over the assembly.

Stochastic detail, broad variation, sheltered surfaces, anchored runoff, repairs and contact deposits.

The environment layer is evaluated on the GPU over shared prepared maps. It is not baked into exported material tiles.

Local construction masks approximate shelter and deposition; this is not a fluid simulation or full ray-traced exposure.
